title.narrative: End Term Evaluation of Rights and Democracy (Igual) Program

description.narrative: To assess the extent to which the results of IGUAL were achieved during its implementation, the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands intends to conduct IGUAL’s final evaluation. The main objective of the evaluation is to understand the extent in which the approach and methodology used in the IGUAL programme were pivotal in achieving the expected results. Specifically, the evaluation aims to analyse and discuss how the approach and methodology used in implementing the programme had a significant impact on the changes made, not only at the policy level, but also on the behaviour of communities and State agents in the areas of Human Rights and Democracy. The analysis should not only indicate whether the approach and methodology used for the IGUAL programme can be used for future projects of the same nature and dimension but also propose the type of adjustments that the consultants consider necessary to respond to similar demands in fragile contexts of rapid change, such as Mozambique.
